concerns.text: FR‑004 specifies a mixed‑effects model with Subject as a random effect (1|Subject), yet the plan describes only an OLS regression (`DSRT ~ Entropy + Age + Sex + MeanFD`) without any random‑effect term, leaving the functional requirement unfulfilled.

The plan states “All scripts accept a `--seed` argument; random seeds are fixed in `src/constants.py`,” which is not referenced by any FR or SC in the specification, representing an over‑reach beyond the documented requirements.
